Calendar Sources & Coverage

Source: the nine-page school calendar scan supplied on 10 October 2026. These are transcriptions of the printed schedule; later school notices may supersede them.

  • Missing spread: Classes III–V, January–March 2027; Classes VI–X, April–June 2026. The all-class holiday list remains available.
  • Holiday ranges: the master holiday list governs vacation ranges and reopening days. Printed counts are retained separately.
  • Date changes: Milad-Ul-Nabi is marked subject to moon visibility. Karma, Makar Sankranti and Id-Ul-Fitr carry a “subject to change” marker.
  • Unclear details: bottom footnotes on the holiday page are partly hidden. A second mock-exam entry on 7 December does not repeat its class. The main table gives Birsa Jayanti as 15 November; its footnote contains an inconsistent older date.
  • Corrections: the pasted extraction's dates and class assignments were replaced wherever the scan clearly differed. Unsubstantiated LKG handwriting and April session entries were not invented.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is this the official school website?

No. This is an independently developed school exhibition project. It is not officially authorized and does not accept payments or applications.

Does Shyamalian work without internet?

School-information lookup uses the saved JavaScript dataset. No API, subscription or network connection is required by the code. External source links need internet.

Are these live school updates?
Are all activity pages available?

No. Classes III–V January–March 2027 and VI–X April–June 2026 spreads are missing. All-class holidays remain available. See the source coverage notes.
